summary: Israeli forces killed two senior Hamas internal security commanders in Gaza City within 24 hours, while Iran conducted multiple missile and UAV launches across Khuzestan, Kurdistan, Hormozgan, and Isfahan provinces. Simultaneously, Israeli artillery and aircraft struck locations in southern Lebanon, and Houthi forces attacked Riyadh's Public Investment Fund tower for the second time in five days. CENTCOM acknowledged Syrian cooperation in thwarting an Iranian weapons smuggling operation.
key_points: IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Hamas northern Gaza internal security director Muhammad Abu al-Awf in a Gaza City strike that also killed his wife and two teenage daughters. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)

Hamas chief of internal security Naim Abu Nahal was killed in an Israeli strike yesterday, and was part of a "secret circle" holding the body of Israeli soldier Oron Shaul. (Source: @manniefabian/59584)

Iran launched a missile from Sarbandar, Khuzestan, and at least three UAVs from Behbahan, Khuzestan, with additional UAV launches from Omidiyeh and Ramhormoz. (Source: @shin_persian/12898, @shin_persian/12895, @shin_persian/12899, @shin_persian/12887)

Two blasts were heard in Sirik, Hormozgan, possibly missile launches, while jet activity was reported over southern and western Iran and Baharestan, Isfahan. (Source: @shin_persian/12890, @shin_persian/12891, @shin_persian/12892)
Israeli artillery shelled Al-Mansouri and Zibqin in southern Lebanon, and warplanes operated over the sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/55079, @redlinkleb/55078)
Israeli forces dropped flares over Shqra, Doubieh, and Taloussa in southern Lebanon, accompanied by machine-gun sweeping fire at Taloussa. (Source: @redlinkleb/55066, @redlinkleb/55086)
Houthi forces struck Riyadh's Public Investment Fund tower for the second time in five days, injuring 11 people. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10395)
CENTCOM commander Brad Cooper thanked Syria for thwarting an Iranian drug and weapons smuggling operation. (Source: @N12chat/236951)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces eliminated Hamas's top two internal security commanders in Gaza City within 24 hours, degrading the group's internal control apparatus. Iran executed a coordinated multi-province missile and UAV launch sequence, indicating heightened operational readiness. Concurrently, Israeli forces conducted artillery shelling, air patrols, and flare operations in southern Lebanon, while Houthi militants struck a strategic Saudi target in Riyadh for the second time in a week.

points: Iran launched a ballistic missile from Sarbandar in Khuzestan province at 00:20 local time (2050Z), and at least three UAVs were launched from Behbahan in Khuzestan at 23:57 local time (2027Z), with additional UAV launches reported from Omidiyeh at 00:42 local (2112Z) and Ramhormoz at 22:58 local (1928Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12898, @shin_persian/12895, @shin_persian/12899, @shin_persian/12887)

A missile was launched from the outskirts of Qorveh in Kurdistan province at 22:55 local (1925Z), and two blasts were heard in Sirik, Hormozgan province at 1929Z, assessed as possible missile launches. (Source: @shin_persian/12885, @shin_persian/12890)

Jet activity was detected over southern and western Iran, including over Baharestan in Isfahan province at 23:28 local (1958Z), and numerous UAV launches originated from Omidiyeh airbase in Khuzestan. (Source: @shin_persian/12891, @shin_persian/12892)

No explosions were reported on Qeshm island despite regional activity; the Sirik blasts remain ambiguous between outgoing launches and incoming strikes, with video evidence under verification. (Source: @shin_persian/12891)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted a targeted strike in Gaza City's Shati camp killing Hamas northern Gaza internal security director Muhammad Abu al-Awf, 47, along with his wife and two teenage daughters, stating he was advancing attacks on Israeli troops and rebuilding capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)

The previous day, an Israeli strike killed Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal, who had been in the role for two months after his predecessor Muein al-Arabid was captured by Shin Bet in September; Abu Nahal was part of a "secret circle" holding the body of Staff Sgt. Oron Shaul. (Source: @manniefabian/59583, @manniefabian/59584)
Israeli artillery shelled Al-Mansouri and Zibqin in southern Lebanon, while warplanes conducted flights over the southern Lebanon sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/55079, @redlinkleb/55078)

Israeli forces dropped illumination flares over the areas between Shqra and Doubieh, and over Taloussa, the latter accompanied by a machine-gun sweeping operation. (Source: @redlinkleb/55066, @redlinkleb/55086)
Israeli warplanes were tracked over southern Lebanon on live mapping systems on two separate occasions. (Source: @redlinkleb/55078, @redlinkleb/55090)

Hamas's internal security apparatus, responsible for maintaining the group's rule in Gaza, executing opponents, and operating torture facilities, has lost its top two commanders in 24 hours, significantly degrading its management capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)

The IDF asserts that Abu al-Awf was systematically violating the ceasefire by advancing attacks on Israeli troops and civilians and rebuilding Hamas's military capabilities, justifying his targeting to remove the threat. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)
Abu al-Awf was slated to replace Naim Abu Nahal as chief of the internal security apparatus, indicating a planned leadership succession now disrupted. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)
The internal security apparatus had held the body of Israeli soldier Staff Sgt. Oron Shaul for years within a "secret circle" that included Abu Nahal. (Source: @manniefabian/59584)
Israeli artillery conducted shelling on the towns of Al-Mansouri and Zibqin in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/55079)
Israeli warplanes flew over the southern Lebanon sector, tracked on live mapping systems. (Source: @redlinkleb/55078, @redlinkleb/55090)
Israeli forces dropped illumination flares between Shqra and Doubieh, and over Taloussa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/55066, @redlinkleb/55086)
At Taloussa, flare drops were accompanied by a machine-gun sweeping campaign. (Source: @redlinkleb/55086)
CENTCOM commander General Brad Cooper publicly thanked Syria for its assistance in thwarting an Iranian smuggling operation involving drugs and weapons. (Source: @N12chat/236951)
The Syrian cooperation was specifically credited with success in interdicting drug and weapons smuggling, implying cross-border interdiction efforts. (Source: @N12chat/236951)
Houthi forces struck the Public Investment Fund tower in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for the second time in five days, causing 11 injuries. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10395)

key_developments: IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas northern Gaza internal security director Muhammad Abu al-Awf in a Gaza City strike, eliminating a commander actively violating the ceasefire by planning attacks on Israeli forces and rebuilding military capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59583)

Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal was killed in an Israeli strike 24 hours earlier; he was part of a secret circle holding the body of Israeli soldier Oron Shaul, and his death precedes Abu al-Awf's planned succession. (Source: @manniefabian/59584)

Iran conducted a multi-province missile and UAV launch sequence: a missile from Sarbandar (Khuzestan), three UAVs from Behbahan (Khuzestan), additional UAVs from Omidiyeh and Ramhormoz (Khuzestan), a missile from Qorveh (Kurdistan), and possible launches from Sirik (Hormozgan). (Source: @shin_persian/12898, @shin_persian/12895, @shin_persian/12899, @shin_persian/12887, @shin_persian/12885, @shin_persian/12890)

Jet activity was observed over southern and western Iran and over Baharestan, Isfahan, coinciding with the UAV and missile launches, suggesting coordinated air operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12891, @shin_persian/12892)

Israeli artillery shelled Al-Mansouri and Zibqin in southern Lebanon, while warplanes patrolled the sector and forces dropped flares over Shqra, Doubieh, and Taloussa with machine-gun fire at Taloussa. (Source: @redlinkleb/55079, @redlinkleb/55078, @redlinkleb/55066, @redlinkleb/55086)

Houthi militants attacked Riyadh's Public Investment Fund tower for the second time in five days, injuring 11 people, demonstrating continued long-range strike capability against Saudi strategic infrastructure. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10395)

CENTCOM commander Brad Cooper acknowledged Syrian success in thwarting an Iranian drug and weapons smuggling operation, indicating rare operational cooperation between US-backed forces and the Syrian government. (Source: @N12chat/236951)
